description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewService class within the Api\V8\Service namespace. It provides methods to retrieve list view column definitions for a specific module, integrating with other helper classes and facades. It includes class properties, constructor, and the getListViewDefs method, which fetches and constructs display column data with localization support.

classes.name: ListViewService
classes.description: A service class providing list view column definitions for modules, supporting localization and integration with other component helpers.

methods.name: getListViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieves display column definitions for a specified module, merging default interface attributes with actual column data, applying localization for labels.
